meta.etranger.title: French international school AI platform: Galac6 for French schools abroad
meta.etranger.description: Galac6, the AI platform for accredited French schools abroad: same curriculum as in France, dictations and paper copies marked, brevet and bac practice with 112 official papers set outside France, data hosted in France. Free 3-month pilot for 3 classes.
meta.etranger.og_title: Galac6: the AI platform for French schools abroad
meta.etranger.og_description: The French curriculum, from CP to Terminale, with AI: time saved for your teachers, tailored follow-up of every pupil, brevet and bac prepared from abroad. Free 3-month pilot for 3 classes.
etranger.hero.title: The AI platform for French schools abroad
etranger.hero.sub: Galac6 follows the French curriculum, from CP to Terminale. Your teachers save time, and every pupil gets tailored follow-up, wherever your school is.
etranger.hero.g1: Same curriculum as in France: nothing to adapt.
etranger.hero.g2: Brevet and bac from abroad, with the official papers set outside France.
etranger.hero.g3: Data hosted in France, artificial intelligence processed in Europe.
etranger.pilot.offer: Free pilot: 3 months for 3 classes, no commitment. Then a quote in euros.
etranger.who.title: For schools accredited by the French Ministry of Education
etranger.who.lead: French primary schools, collèges and lycées abroad, whatever their status.
etranger.who.l1: Schools directly managed by the AEFE
etranger.who.l4: Mission laïque française (MLF), AFLEC and other networks
etranger.who.note: You already follow the French curriculum: Galac6 works for you as it is, there is nothing to adapt.
etranger.feats.title: All of Galac6, for your school, wherever it is
etranger.f1.t: The French curriculum, as it is
etranger.f1.d: From CP to Terminale, the same topics and the same exams as in France. An AI tutor built on sound teaching methods guides each pupil step by step, without giving away the answer.
etranger.f2.d: Dictations read aloud and marked, paper copies scanned then marked, quizzes ready in a few minutes. The time saved goes back to teaching.
etranger.f3.d: You see what each pupil has mastered and where they struggle. You know who to help, and with what.
etranger.f4.d: Your pupils practise on official past papers, including those set outside France, as mock exams with detailed marking.
etranger.f5.d: Your classes, their averages and the topics to work on again, brought together in a space for the leadership team.
etranger.f6.d: Import your pupil list from a file exported from Pronote or École Directe, or from a simple pasted list. No need to enter them one by one.
etranger.f7.d: Emails to families are sent in French or in English, as your school chooses.
etranger.f8.d: Automatic messages follow your school's local time, not Paris time.
etranger.f9.d: Data is hosted in France, in the European Union, and processed in line with the GDPR. It is never sold.
etranger.stats.title: The brevet and the bac, prepared from abroad
etranger.stats.s2.l: official brevet and bac past papers, including over 250 in maths
etranger.stats.s3.l: official papers set outside France: 76 brevet, 29 French bac and 7 maths bac
etranger.offer.title: Try Galac6 before you decide
etranger.offer.quote.l1: Based on the number of pupils and the modules chosen
etranger.faq.title: Your questions
etranger.faq.q1: Do we need to adapt Galac6 to our school?
etranger.faq.a1: No. Galac6 follows the official French curriculum, from CP to Terminale, the same as in your school. Your teachers find the topics, levels and exams they already know.
etranger.faq.q2: How do we add our pupils?
etranger.faq.a2: You import your pupil list from a file: an export from Pronote or École Directe, or a simple pasted list. No need to enter them one by one.
etranger.faq.q3: Not all our families read French. What can we do?
etranger.faq.a3: Emails to families are sent in French or in English, as your school chooses, and at your school's local time.
etranger.faq.a4: Data is hosted in France, in Paris, and Galac6's main artificial intelligence is processed in Europe. Only the pupil's teachers and their school's leadership can see their work. Full details are on the pupil data page (in French).
etranger.faq.a5: The pilot is free for 3 months for 3 classes, with no commitment. After that, we send you a quote in euros based on the number of your pupils and the modules chosen.
etranger.form.lead: Tell us in a few lines who you are. We will reply with a pilot proposal, a demo or a quote in euros.
etranger.f.email.err: Enter a full email address, for example firstname.lastname@lycee-francais.org.
etranger.side.next.l3: We launch the pilot for 3 classes, then you receive a quote in euros.
etranger.back: See the Galac6 page for all schools
